protocol: One training-only consistency term. Shift normalized feature rows by +1 with zero mean fill and no wrap; mean Huber between shifted logits at rows 1..52 and detached original logits at rows 0..51, delta=1, coefficient=1. Keep the original supervised setwise objective, targets, optimizer steps, architecture, cutoff selection and inference. One fit, no sweep or refit.

training_grid_consistency.loss: mean Huber over batch and overlapping rows
